_source: Pipelife online product catalog, PE100 PN16 SDR11 pressure pipe dimension table (catalog.pipelife.com/pl-en/articlelist/pe-80-i-pe-100-198966/193405/pe100-s-1w-sdr11-blue), retrieved 2026-09-21. Pipelife Bulgaria (pipelife.bg) did not have a dedicated geothermal-probe-branded product page at time of retrieval; this uses Pipelife's group-wide PE100 SDR11 PN16 pressure pipe catalog, the material/dimension class used for geothermal probe installation.
_material_note: The fetched catalog entry lists this dimension series as PE100 (not explicitly labelled PE100-RC on that page). PE100-RC of the same SDR/nominal diameter has IDENTICAL wall-thickness dimensions to PE100 -- 'RC' denotes a crack-resistance material grade, not a different dimensional standard -- so these dimensions apply equally to Pipelife's PE100-RC grade. Pipelife's own technical catalog ('Systemy cisnieniowe PVC, PE, PE 100 RC', pipelife.pl) confirms PE100-RC is offered within the same SDR dimension system.
_material_conductivity_note: No pipe-material thermal conductivity is published in the fetched catalog entry. k_p uses the same industry-standard 0.40 W/m.K value used elsewhere in this engine for PE-family pipe materials -- not an unsourced Pipelife-specific figure.
